panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib faces the newly cleared wall in the admin hub as chairs separate. Jax is beside him with the access-label marker. Their workspace, rather than a full cast tableau, anchors the opening.
PANEL 2 — Close two-shot: Jax shows Zib the mislabeled access number and marks the correct digits. Keep the label legible; no meeting crowd surrounds them.
PANEL 3 — Mira writes PRESSURE CORRELATION — CONTENT UNKNOWN on her sample record. Noola looks over her shoulder without touching the sample.
PANEL 4 — Glorp and Kreeb work side by side at the record rack, reducing the owner rule to one modest card that does not require a seminar.
PANEL 5 — Astra lifts the portable meeting screen clear of the wall while Pixa gathers its cable. The unnecessary meeting furniture leaves the actual work area.
PANEL 6 — Pixa walks with Astra holding the neatly coiled cable and delivers her ordinary closing remark. Keep this a small departing pair, not eight people in the frame.

summary: Six focused beats in the admin hub as the meeting dissolves into actual work: Zib and Jax regain access, Mira and Noola preserve the unknown sample result, Glorp and Kreeb simplify ownership, and Astra moves the meeting screen away while Pixa carries the cable.
